name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
quirks: Script-extender mods need SKSE64. Add it from a file like any mod; Luma then starts the game through skse64_loader.exe.
Luma doesn't turn plugins (.esp/.esm/.esl) on in plugins.txt yet; new plugins may need turning on from a load order tool or the in-game Creations menu.
Anniversary Edition content is part of the same game.
